rules.description: At submission the main text is 9 pages or fewer (10 for the camera-ready). References, appendices after the bibliography, the ethics and reproducibility statements, the LLM-usage section and acknowledgements do not count. Source: https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2026/AuthorGuide
Body text uses 10 point type with 11 point spacing. Source: https://github.com/ICLR/Master-Template/raw/master/iclr2026.zip (iclr2026_conference.tex)
Pages are US Letter, not A4. Source: https://github.com/ICLR/Master-Template/raw/master/iclr2026.zip (iclr2026_conference.tex)
Review is double-blind: the submission must not identify its authors. Source: https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2026/AuthorGuide
